verses.mystical_translation: How long wilt thou forget me, O the Living Presence? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
Consider and hear me, O the Living Presence my the Divine: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy deliverance and wholeness.
I will sing unto the the Living Presence, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

contemplative_note: Lament can hold despair and trust in the same breath.
safety_note: Feeling forgotten by God is allowed inside scripture and should never be treated as spiritual failure or grounds for self-harm.
